items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: As soon as I go to the Dr. Dre studio, I walk in, Kendrick’s there

ctx.x: The second night, before I walked on to play, Terrace called me, he was like, “yo, I’m at the studio, at Dr. Dre’s studio. Can you come here right after you finish your session?” I was like, “aright.” So this is the funny part about this whole thing. I go in, I finish my recording session, mind you “Covered” is a trio album but it’s not straight ahead jazz. You know we’re pretty much doing cover songs and it’s not [scats] you know. As soon as I go to the Dr. Dre studio, I walk in, Kendrick’s there, I didn’t even…
“I want you to play on some joints.” I was like, “cool.” The first song was [scats a swing groove].
